title: Hamburg bicycle agent simulation
summary: Agent-based simulation of 1,000 cyclists riding from population-weighted origins to Hamburg Hauptbahnhof, with signal timing, queues and construction sites.

data.text: Each simulated cyclist combines a bike type (conventional, e-bike, cargo), a pace, a routing preference (shortest, comfortable, protected), traffic compliance and construction awareness. Origins are drawn by the 2025 resident population of each Stadtteil; everyone rides to Hauptbahnhof within a one-hour departure window starting at 11:00.
